pages.text: Encrypted DNA → decoded DNA. Decoding reveals the helix's existing gene so it can be infused.

Default storage: 20,000 energy.$(br)Base use: 20 energy/tick.$(br)Base timer: 200 ticks (10 seconds).$(br)Maximum overclockers: 5.$(br2)The completion tick also consumes energy, preserving the original machine timing. Progress resets if processing cannot continue.
